notes.title: Big Ol' Update
notes.notes: [p]I have added an entirely new level. Once you complete the sidescroller level you'll have to go through a production factory where you might meet our Robot friend. [/p][p][/p][p]As well as this there have been a few refinements and tweaks [/p][p][/p][p]Just in time for that Steam Summer Sale too. So get it now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018750/2a3afae5a8b91983d1b068f636471d865e15acaf.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes June 25
notes.notes:
[b]Attention bears [/b]

This is the [b]biggest [/b]update yet.

A whole new level. After the sidescroller type level you will go into a production factory.

A few minor refinements along the way too.

notes.title: Joeseppi Feature
notes.notes:
Woo. Joeseppi played my game but, there were issues. So I've tried to tweak some of them.

Tank boss is now shorter and a bit easier. 
Changed dead screen. Removed bad ai imagery.
You can now shoot some lights and break them in the office sections.
Minor lighting improvements
Added Rogue Robot posters

notes.title: New Year. New Update.
notes.notes:
New Year. New Update. 

Optimised file size.
Fixed skateboard rotation bug.
Added controller vibration
Minor tweaks here and there.

notes.title: Patch June 27th
notes.notes: Mostly quality of life tweaks. Nothing major but can now skip the cutscene and better integration of speed run mode. Enjoy.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for the feedback so far.
This update improves some collision issues, music issues and helicopter fight.

New
Another hidden area can be found on farm map.

notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.notes:
Just a few small bug fixes and tweaks. More to come.
Oh and in the sidescroller level you can now jump on bad guys heads
